verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a hardware AI accelerator with a PyTorch-based SDK, not a hosted service exposing an HTTP API, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this product type. The docs mention model serving via third-party frameworks such as vLLM, but that does not make the accelerator itself an API-spec-publishing product. The 404 OpenAPI probe results are consistent with this but do not change the axis judgment.
